Never infer zero. subtotal_mismatches <- function(data) {   analysis_keys(data, c("Region", "period"))   aimag_sums <- data |>     filter(nchar(Region) == 3, Region != "511") |>     mutate(region = substr(Region, 1, 1)) |>     summarise(aimag_sum = analysis_sum(value), .by = c(region, period))   region_totals <- data |>     filter(Region %in% as.character(1:4)) |>     select(region = Region, period, region_total = value)   full_join(aimag_sums, region_totals, by = join_by(region, period), relationship = "one-to-one") |>     mutate(check = case_when(       !is.finite(aimag_sum) | !is.finite(region_total) ~ "Uncheckable",       aimag_sum != region_total ~ "Needs review",       .default = "Agrees"     )) |>     filter(check != "Agrees") } annual_tbl <- "DT_NSO_2100_002V1" monthly_tbl <- "DT_NSO_2100_002V2" maternal_annual <- nso_data(annual_tbl, list(   Region = nso_dim_values(annual_tbl, "Region")$code,   Year = nso_dim_values(annual_tbl, "Year", labels = "en")$label_en ), labels = "en") |> mutate(period = Year_en) maternal_monthly <- nso_data(monthly_tbl, list(   Region = nso_dim_values(monthly_tbl, "Region")$code,   Month = nso_table_periods(monthly_tbl)$label ), labels = "en") |> mutate(period = Month_en) annual_checks <- subtotal_mismatches(maternal_annual) monthly_checks <- subtotal_mismatches(maternal_monthly) count(annual_checks, check) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   check            n #>   <chr>        <int> #> 1 Needs review     1 #> 2 Uncheckable     51 count(monthly_checks, check) #> # A tibble: 1 × 2 #>   check           n #>   <chr>       <int> #> 1 Uncheckable    76 filter(annual_checks, check == "Needs review") #> # A tibble: 1 × 5 #>   region period aimag_sum region_total check        #>   <chr>  <chr>      <dbl>        <dbl> <chr>        #> 1 4      2017          22            2 Needs review
